title.zh: SpaceX拟融资400亿美元采购英伟达芯片，Apollo牵头安排
title.en: SpaceX拟融资400亿美元采购英伟达芯片，Apollo牵头安排

current_state.zh: 据SEC文件，SpaceX与Apollo已就GPU集群及相关设备签署具有约束力的主融资租赁协议，本金付款总额预计将达400亿美元，该租赁预计将在2027年上半年GPU交付时启动。
current_state.en: SpaceX and Apollo have signed a binding master finance lease for GPU clusters and related equipment, with total principal payments expected to reach $40 billion and the lease expected to start upon GPU delivery in H1 2027, per an SEC filing.

updates.title_zh: SpaceX拟融资400亿美元采购英伟达芯片，Apollo牵头安排
updates.title_en: SpaceX拟融资400亿美元采购英伟达芯片，Apollo牵头安排
updates.what_changed_zh: 据报道，SpaceX正安排约400亿美元融资，由Apollo Global Management牵头，其中包括约100亿美元银行贷款和300亿美元投资级债务，用于购买英伟达芯片并扩大其AI算力建设，Pimco也在洽谈的贷款方之列。
updates.what_changed_en: SpaceX is reportedly arranging roughly $40 billion in financing led by Apollo Global Management — including about $10 billion of bank loans and $30 billion of investment-grade debt — to purchase Nvidia chips and expand its AI compute buildout, with Pimco among the lenders in talks.

updates.title_zh: SpaceX与阿波罗签署400亿美元GPU融资租赁协议，2027年上半年启动
updates.title_en: SpaceX与阿波罗签署400亿美元GPU融资租赁协议，2027年上半年启动
updates.what_changed_zh: SpaceX与Apollo签署具有约束力的主融资租赁协议：Apollo将购买GPU集群及相关设备并租赁给SpaceX，租赁本金付款总额预计达400亿美元，安排将在2027年上半年GPU交付时启动；该信息来自SEC文件。
updates.what_changed_en: SpaceX signed a binding master finance lease with Apollo: Apollo will buy GPU clusters and related equipment and lease them to SpaceX, with total principal payments expected to reach $40 billion, starting when GPUs are delivered in H1 2027, according to an SEC filing.
updates.current_state_zh: 据SEC文件，SpaceX与Apollo已就GPU集群及相关设备签署具有约束力的主融资租赁协议，本金付款总额预计将达400亿美元，该租赁预计将在2027年上半年GPU交付时启动。
updates.current_state_en: SpaceX and Apollo have signed a binding master finance lease for GPU clusters and related equipment, with total principal payments expected to reach $40 billion and the lease expected to start upon GPU delivery in H1 2027, per an SEC filing.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SpaceX signed a binding master finance lease with Apollo under which Apollo will buy GPU clusters and related equipment and lease them to SpaceX, with total principal payments expected to reach $40 billion starting when GPUs are delivered in H1 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_en: SpaceX signed a binding master finance lease with Apollo under which Apollo will buy GPU clusters and related equipment and lease them to SpaceX, with total principal payments expected to reach $40 billion starting when GPUs are delivered in H1 2027.
